alur.deskripsi: BPJS participants receive a referral letter from their registered Primary Care Facility (community health centre or clinic), except for emergency cases which are handled directly in the ER.
Show your ID card, BPJS/KIS card and referral letter at the Registration counter on Level 1, or confirm them through the Mobile JKN app. Membership eligibility is verified in real time.

If inpatient care is required, the patient is placed in a KRIS standard room in the Level 3 zone according to medical indication, with no extra charge as long as the entitlement and guarantee class are met.

ketentuan: A staged referral letter from the registered primary care facility (except in a medical emergency, which can be handled directly in the ER).
An active KIS / BPJS Kesehatan card in the patient's name, membership status is verified at registration.
Care follows the Clinical Pathway and the national INA CBG tariff standard, with no co payment in a KRIS standard room.
If certain essential medicines or medical devices are unavailable, the admission officer will explain the cross referral procedure.
Discharge on medical indication, or at the patient's own request (APS), must be signed by the family and the BPJS Care Center team.

kontak.lokasi: Partnership & Cooperation Director, Level 9, Administration Tower
